title: Practice: Much, many, few, how many, several

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson before this one teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: The temperature was below freezing for several days.
exercises.why: After «несколько» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Kato asked him many questions about the United States.
exercises.ru: Като задал ему много ___ о США.
exercises.why: After «много» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
